```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys, pathlib
# This document sits outside the Quarto project, so find the helpers by
# walking up to the repository root rather than to the project root.
for candidate in [pathlib.Path.cwd(), *pathlib.Path.cwd().parents]:
    if (candidate / "docs" / "_helpers" / "load_runs.py").exists():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(candidate / "docs" / "_helpers"))
        break
from IPython.display import Markdown
import pandas as pd
import load_runs as lr

CITE = lambda run_id: lr.cite(run_id, link=False)
RUNS_TABLE = lambda frame: lr.runs_table(frame, link=False)
ESM2_XREF = "pending decision about its role"

SMOKE = lr.latest("physchem", "smoke-test")
CHAR = lr.latest("physchem", "characterisation")
props = lr.read_output(CHAR, "physchem_properties.tsv")
p = lr.params(CHAR)
stripped = props[props.construct_form == "tag_stripped"].set_index("binder_id")
as_given = props[props.construct_form == "as_given"].set_index("binder_id")
```

## Provenance

```{python}
#| echo: false
rows = []
for run_id in [SMOKE, CHAR]:
    m = lr.manifest(run_id)
    rows.append({
        "run_id": run_id,
        "timestamp (UTC)": m.get("timestamp_utc"),
        "stage": m.get("stage"),
        "status": m.get("status"),
        "code version": m.get("code_version") or "not recorded",
    })
pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("run_id")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
rows = []
for run_id in [SMOKE, CHAR]:
    for entry in lr.manifest(run_id).get("inputs") or []:
        rows.append({
            "run_id": run_id,
            "input": entry.get("path"),
            "bytes": entry.get("bytes"),
            "sha256": str(entry.get("sha256", ""))[:16] + "…",
        })
Markdown("Inputs, with hashes, so it is possible to tell whether a later copy "
         "of a dataset is the one these numbers came from:")
pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("run_id") if rows else Markdown("_none recorded_")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
versions = lr.tool_versions(CHAR)
Markdown(
    "Tool versions:\n\n"
    + "\n".join(f"- `{name}` {version}" for name, version in
                sorted(versions.items()))
    if versions else Markdown("_no tool versions recorded_")
)
```
